# src/utils

`src/utils` supplies core infrastructure for `src/cli.ts` and `src/session.ts`, implementing file-based concurrency via `acquireLock`, ANSI-colored output via `logger.ts` exports, and input sanitization via `validateSessionName`.

## Contents

- [lock.ts](./lock.ts): Implements `LockError`, `acquireLock`, `withLock`, `withLockAsync` using mkdir atomicity and `LOCK_STALE_MS` for stale detection in `isLockStale`.
- [logger.ts](./logger.ts): Defines `LogLevel`, `LOG_LEVELS`, `COLORS` and `debug`/`info`/`warn`/`error`/`success` functions writing to `console.error`.
- [validation.ts](./validation.ts): Enforces `SESSION_NAME_REGEX`, `MAX_SESSION_NAME_LENGTH`, `DANGEROUS_CHARS` via `validateSessionName`, `validateCommitMessage`, `validateFilePaths`.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `LOCK_STALE_MS = 30_000` defines lock expiration threshold in `isLockStale`.
- `SESSION_NAME_REGEX=/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$/` validates session identifiers in `validateSessionName`.
- `DANGEROUS_CHARS=/[;&|`$(){}[\]!#~'"\\<>]/` blocks shell injection in `validateFilePaths`.
- `validateCommitMessage` rejects message length > 500.
- `setLogLevel` modifies `currentLevel` threshold affecting `shouldLog`.
- `sanitizeForDisplay` strips control chars `[\x00-\x1f\x7f]`.
- `LockError` includes `message` and `lockPath` properties with `name="LockError"`.

## Runtime Dependencies

- `fs` module provides `existsSync`, `mkdirSync`, `unlinkSync`, `writeFileSync`, `readFileSync` for `lock.ts` operations.
- `os.hostname()` identifies host in `LockInfo` struct.
- `Bun.sleepSync` handles `retryDelayMs` in `acquireLock`.
- `console.error` stream receives all `logger.ts` outputs except `print`.
- `process.kill(pid, 0)` checks `isProcessAlive` within `isLockStale`.
